rows.label: tlk70000069_05_msg0001
rows.name:
You're chasing Heaven's Holy Grail
toward the Divine Beast's core, right?
Then you're heading the wrong way.

rows.label: tlk70000069_05_msg0002
rows.name:
From here, head toward Lake Alegria
first. There's a woodland path nearby.

rows.label: tlk70000069_05_msg0003
rows.name:
Follow the woodland path a little and
you'll find a great staircase lined
with pillars. Climb it.

rows.label: tlk70000069_05_msg0004
rows.name:
At the top of the staircase,
you'll find a gate that leads
to the Divine Beast's core.

rows.label: tlk70000069_05_msg0005
rows.name:
But apparently that gate has been kept
sealed by successive kings of Iira for
many years.

rows.label: tlk70000069_05_msg0006
rows.name:
No one knows anymore what creatures
are beyond it or how it's structured.

rows.label: tlk70000069_05_msg0007
rows.name:
In any case, no matter what you find
beyond the gate, it's bound to be
dangerous. Prepare yourselves.
